description: This file defines an immutable Java class 'ImmutableResourceStatus' implementing 'ResourceStatus'. It models the status of a resource, providing methods for JSON serialization/deserialization, accessors, and equality checks. It is part of a connectivity model within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ImmutableResourceStatus
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the ResourceStatus interface, representing the status of a resource with methods for JSON conversion and equality.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods to create new instances of ImmutableResourceStatus with specified parameters.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the resource address if present.

methods.name: getStatusDetails
methods.description: Returns an Optional with additional status details, if available.

methods.name: getInStateSince
methods.description: Returns an Optional with the Instant since the resource has been in the current state.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the resource status to a JsonObject, applying schema version and predicate filtering.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableResourceStatus instance from a JSON object.
